about: What a reader must find in each PNG of this folder (docs/architecture/ink.md, The container). `width` is the canvas width of the drawing the PNG carries, `problems` the messages it reports (compared as text, in order), `pixelsPerPoint` how many pixels the PNG has to a point of its canvas: its pHYs chunk (pixels to a metre; 72 dots to an inch is one to a point) to a hundredth, and 2 when it has none. When a PNG has two inKJ chunks the last one that reads wins, and one that does not read is reported and passed over.

cases.name: one chunk, at 2 pixels to a point
two inKJ chunks: the last one wins
two inKJ chunks, the last with a wrong CRC: the first is used and the second is reported
a drawing 5,000 points wide is stored at 8,192 pixels, and says so
